# pangolin_domain (Data Source)

Looks up a single Pangolin domain by ID. Use this when you already have the `domain_id` and want a one-shot read; for browsing every domain in the org, use `pangolin_domains`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Single-domain lookup by ID.
data "pangolin_domain" "main" {
  id = "egcq4bwo41tak9o"
}

output "is_verified" {
  value = data.pangolin_domain.main.verified
}

# Surface a remediation hint if the last verification attempt failed.
output "verification_error" {
  value = (
    data.pangolin_domain.main.failed
    ? coalesce(data.pangolin_domain.main.error_message, "(no message)")
    : null
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The domain ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `base_domain` (String) The base domain name.
- `cert_resolver` (String) Name of the cert resolver in use, or `null` when the default resolver applies.
- `config_managed` (Boolean) Whether the domain was provisioned via static configuration (`true`) or via the API (`false`).
- `custom_cert_resolver` (String) Custom cert resolver override, or `null` to use the default.
- `error_message` (String) Last error reported during verification, or `null` when no error.
- `failed` (Boolean) Whether the last verification attempt failed.
- `prefer_wildcard_cert` (Boolean) Whether to prefer issuing a wildcard certificate for this domain.
- `tries` (Number) Number of verification attempts performed by Pangolin.
- `type` (String) The domain type (`ns`, `cname`, `wildcard`).
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain has been verified.
